sourceState: Uncommitted working tree. Exact tracked diff and relevant new files preserved under .build/native-beta-101. Build cache reused from beta 100, with its published manifest preserved.
changes: Participation can offer to take a question when a participant asks whether the local attendee is on the line or can respond.
Adjacent verified speech from the same participant can provide the missing name in a split request. Current requests, exact name evidence and the approved roster determine the reply.
Quiet verified local turns receive a current-request check so explicit hearing checks can produce a reply. Typed diagnostics identify proposal and assessment outcomes.
Suggested reply buttons use localized stance identifiers. Older brief hold and hold labels resolve to the existing translated label.
validation: 43 targeted native tests passed, covering participant identity, fragment adjacency, lexical name boundaries, localization, on-device schema and muted-microphone WebRTC playback.

33 synthetic outcomes matched expectations using the configured gpt-5.4-mini through normal signed-app settings and Keychain APIs. Each full-name and first-name split request passed four times. All 19 negative trials stayed silent.
24 Apple on-device replay outcomes matched expectations across two exact-source runs.
Native two-peer WebRTC decoded assistant audio with the local monitor active and the simulated raw microphone gated to silence.
Archive source hashes, app notarization, Gatekeeper, translated signed-app resources, feed signatures and public download hashes verified.
diagnosis: Beta 100 logs identified assessmentDeclined before synthesis. A signed probe against the configured provider and exact published beta 100 source reproduced rejection of both intact and split forms of the screenshot request.
notVerified: End-to-end automatic speech in a live provider meeting with the configured voice clone. Synthetic model replays synthesized built-in Russian TTS and sent no room audio.
Separate notarization of the outer DMG.
